question: The marked price of an old article is ₹4,000. A buys it at two successive discounts of 15% and 10%. He spends ₹1,140 on repairing it and sells it for ₹5,000. His profit or loss percentage is ______. (rounded to the nearest integer)
solution:
Given:

Selling Price = Rs. 5000

Marked Price = Rs. 5000

Discount percentage = 10% and 15%

Formula used:

Profit percentage = {(SP - CP)/CP} × 100

where,

CP = Cost price

SP = Selling price

Calculation:

Cost price of A = 4000 × (1 - 15/100) × (1 - 10/100)

= 4000 × 17/20 × 9/10

= 3060

Total CP including repairing charge = 3060 + 1140

= 4200

Profit percentage = {(SP - CP)/CP} × 100

⇒ {(5000 - 4200)/4200} × 100

⇒ 800/4200 × 100

⇒ 19%(approx.)

∴ The answer is 19%.
